DQ-F1-1.decision: one global application presentation option; no per-object attribute

DQ-F1-2.decision: Graphics View 1 only; GV2 outside the authorized implementation design

DQ-F1-3.decision: screen-only; never in print, clipboard, image, LaTeX, DXF or other exports

DQ-F1-4.previous: hollow triangle L=10 px W=4 px, object colour
DQ-F1-4.decision: discreet hollow triangular arrowhead, nominal 10 x 4 device pixels, object colour; geometry and placement presentation-only
DQ-F1-4.implementationDesign: axial length 10, total base 4, half-width 2 device pixels (OTQ-F1-3, v1.1; the v1.0 half-width-4 reading is superseded); 1 px outline, background interior; anchors of design section 5

DQ-F1-5.decision: positive eligibility matrix of constructively oriented or demonstrably inherited orientations; authority GeoLine.getDirection validated against path parametrization and construction semantics; not getDirectionInD3; no constructive sense from a directed parametrization of equation coefficients; excluded equation-defined or convention-dependent routes documented and suppressed until separately admitted; unknown or unverified orientations not guessed
DQ-F1-5.implementationDesign: eligibility matrix v1: admitted A1-A17, excluded X1-X10, recursive fail-closed admission of orienting inputs

DQ-F1-6.decision: global preference geocedg.view.orientation-cue.v1, default OFF, survives restart, not serialized, New/Open do not modify it
DQ-F1-6.implementationDesign: values shown/hidden, invalid reads OFF without write-back, portable store, no undo, repaint of every window, never read by Classic

DQ-F1-7.decision: suppress undefined, non-finite or degenerate, effectively hidden, insufficient visible extent, redundant directional decorations; never an arrow for an invisible or inadmissible object; inversions faithful to the kernel, never smoothed or reassigned
DQ-F1-7.implementationDesign: predicate and degeneration table of design section 4; redundant decorations = the three segment midpoint arrow decorations

DQ-F1-8.decision: presentation-only overlay in GeoCeDG Desktop Graphics View 1; no new GeoElement, kernel algorithm, persistence attribute, construction dependency or shared drawable change; BOUNDED_PHASE conditioned on the entry gate; registered PHASE covers admissibility, direction, rendering, lifecycle, visibility, preferences, product-profile regressions

DQ-F1-9.decision: one declarative menu action and a synchronized Layout & Presentation control; catalog 130 -> 131; the delta alone does not imply INTEGRATED_PHASE; prove catalog completeness, stable IDs, projections, status synchronization and profile pins; stop on unexpected inherited-class modifications or a broader product contract
DQ-F1-9.implementationDesign: action presentation.orientation-cue, product-action, preference-only, product-only, action-only, experimental, View group view-visibility-style; checkbox in GeoCeDGPresentationOptionsPanel (OTQ-F1-4)

admitted.A6: AlgoLinePointLine with an admitted line/segment/ray reference: reference sense
admitted.A7: AlgoOrthoLinePointLine with an admitted line/segment/ray reference: reference rotated +90 deg
admitted.A10: AlgoLineBisectorSegment with an admitted segment: (end - start) rotated +90 deg
admitted.A11: AlgoAngularBisectorLines with both inputs admitted: kernel rule
admitted.A12: AlgoTangentLine with an admitted line: sense of the line
admitted.A13: AlgoMirror at a point or a line, admitted source: image sense
admitted.A14: AlgoRotatePoint, AlgoRotate, admitted source: rotated sense
admitted.A16: AlgoDilate, admitted source: source sense times sign of factor

excluded.X3: AlgoTangentPoint (point on the conic and external point)
excluded.X6: AlgoLinePointLine / AlgoOrthoLinePointLine with a GeoFunction reference
excluded.X8: admitted-kind route with an excluded or unknown orienting input
excluded.X9: AlgoShearOrStretch, AlgoAttachCopyToView, AlgoMirror at a conic, other transforms
excluded.X10: every other algorithm, 3D line types, list members, axes, unresolved macros

eligibilityMatrixV1.admittedInputs: GeoPoint (ordered), GeoVector, or a GeoLine/GeoSegment/GeoRay admitted by the matrix

OTQ-F1-1.v1.0: macro inner-route resolution through existing public API; otherwise macros excluded
OTQ-F1-1.decision: conservative rule: admitted only when the internal route and the whole orientation-bearing dependency chain are established reliably through existing supported APIs and every orientation-bearing input satisfies the eligibility contract; no inference from labels, coordinates, proximity, construction indices, presentation state or arbitrary Java references; otherwise suppressed; no new kernel identity, macro serialization or provenance infrastructure

OTQ-F1-2.v1.0: redundant directional decorations = three midpoint arrow decorations, not ending styles
OTQ-F1-2.decision: bounded v1 rule: suppress only for the three segment styles with a midpoint directional arrow; endpoint decorations not reinterpreted, existing segment-style behavior unchanged; broader policy needs separate characterization

OTQ-F1-3.decision: axial length 10, total base width 4, half-width 2 device pixels; object colour; presentation-only; direction from the admitted kernel orientation; no document geometry, scale or exported coordinate modified

OTQ-F1-4.v1.0: host panel chosen at the entry gate
OTQ-F1-4.decision: checkbox in the existing GeoCeDGPresentationOptionsPanel through AppGeoCeDG.newProductPresentationOptionsPanel(), size controls preserved; menu action presentation.orientation-cue and checkbox on geocedg.view.orientation-cue.v1, default OFF, survives restart, not reset by New/Open, no document, XML or undo change; no AppD/OptionsLayoutD hook; stop if not possible

corrections.ER-1: report K5 affine paragraph: probed transforms use GeoLine translate/dilate/rotate/mirror (GeoLine.java:750-751, 763-770, 777-800, 804-811, 817-), not matrixTransform; matrixTransform users (AlgoShearOrStretch, AlgoAttachCopyToView) stay excluded
corrections.ER-2: preparation design AlgoRotate* replaced by explicit AlgoRotate and AlgoRotatePoint rows
